item.title: Top 4 Benefits of Using .NET Blazor Over Angular or React
item.description:
file name: top-4-benefits-of-using-dotnet-blazor-over-angular-or-react.md

Summary

In this guide, we’ll explore the top reasons to choose .NET Blazor over popular JavaScript frameworks like Angular and React. Blazor’s unique integration of C# and WebAssembly allows developers to use a single language for both client and server code, fostering more efficient and robust development. We’ll examine Blazor’s main benefits, offer practical code examples, and compare it to JavaScript-based frameworks.
